questions.questionTextEn: When was the Planning Commission established?
questions.questionTextHi: योजना आयोग की स्थापना कब हुई थी?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). The Planning Commission was a non-Constitutional institution. It is not mentioned in the Constitution. The Commission was formed by a resolution of the Cabinet on March 15, 1950. Prime Minister used to be the ex-oﬃ cio Chairman of this Commission. Its main function was to prepare a 5 year plan for the Union and to give suggestions on annual plans of the States. Almost 70 percent grants to the States by Centre were given on the recommendation of the Commission. NITI Aayog has replaced the Planning Commission. It is also an extra-Constitutional body. It has been formed by a resolution of the Union Cabinet on 1 January, 2015.

questions.questionTextHi: नीति आयोग के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही नहीं है?
optionsEn: It was set up to replace the Planning Commission
It was set up in January 2015
It is based on the principle of Cooperative Federalism
optionsHi: इसकी स्थापना योजना आयोग के स्थान पर की गई थी
इसका एक पूर्णकालिक अध्यक्ष होता है

questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B). Like the Planning Commission, NITI Aayog is an extra-Constitutional body. This Aayog works on the principle of Co-operative federalism.
